segments.name: ClearanceJobs
segments.description: Online career community connecting security-cleared professionals with government contractors, federal agencies and other employers.
segments.evidence: ClearanceJobs is the leading online career community dedicated to connecting security-cleared professionals with employers in a secure and private environment to fill the jobs that safeguard our nation.

segments.name: Dice
segments.description: Technology and engineering career marketplace in the United States connecting tech professionals with employers and recruiters.
segments.evidence: Dice has been a go-to destination for technology and engineering talent in the United States for 35 years.

revenueModel.text: Employers and recruiters pay subscription fees, annually, quarterly or monthly, for recruitment packages to post jobs and access searchable resume databases, plus advertising and lead generation revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive the majority of our revenues from customers who pay fees, either annually, quarterly or monthly, to post jobs on our websites and to access our searchable databases of resumes.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company split its single Tech-focused reportable segment into two reportable segments, ClearanceJobs and Dice.
changes.evidence: The Company previously reported one segment, Tech-focused. Information previously reported in the Tech-focused segment has been separated into ClearanceJobs ("CJ") and Dice, and the Company has two reportable segments: ClearanceJobs and Dice.

changes.text: In 2025, the ClearanceJobs segment acquired AgileATS, an applicant tracking system for government contractors hiring security-cleared professionals.
changes.evidence: On July 31, 2025, the Company's ClearanceJobs reportable segment acquired AgileATS, a leading applicant tracking system (ATS) purpose-built for government contractors and employers hiring security-cleared professionals.
